author: manlares88
quote: I played and is very nostalgic come back to the hyrule. I think the game remains the same soul of the N64 game including news stuff and items. The visual refresh in NS2 is very good to me and is better when you play and play day by day. The soundtrack is impressive and warm in every aspect. Soo I think is the best game in 2026.
